title: Hand-built proof set from a compiled timeline, opened in the DAW (throwaway)
description:
## Intent

Prove the approach before specs: can a set assembled from a captured skeleton plus patched clip elements open and play in time?

## Steps

1. `apricity compile examples/march-blues.apr -o /tmp/march-blues.json` (timeline JSON).
2. A throwaway script in the session scratchpad (never committed) builds a set from `empty.als` plus one audio track per timeline track and one clip per event (warp markers from `Event.warp`, transpose from `semitones`, detune from `tuning_cents`, gain from `gain_db`), gzips it and references the sample files in place.
3. The owner opens it in the DAW: does it open, are clips on the grid, do the chords match `apricity render examples/march-blues.apr -o /tmp/mb.wav` by ear?
4. Record the outcome, every error dialog and every fix in comments, and the decision "template-and-patch" or "generate" in `design/daw-set.md`.

## Verification

Comment on this task with the DAW's reaction and an A/B listening note; `design/daw-set.md` has a "Decisions" entry for the approach.

## Release

No commit of the script. The design note change rides on the design-note task's commit.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Machine side done, DAW side waits for the install.

- Built with a throwaway scratchpad script (template-and-patch, Python stdlib): skeleton = fixture public-12.3.7-minimal.als (its first audio track cloned per Apricity track, its two returns kept), clip template = the arrangement AudioClip of fixture public-12.2.1-techno.als (AudioClip children are identical in 12.2, 12.2.1, 12.2.6 and 12.3.2).
- Input: `target/release/apricity compile examples/march-blues.apr` (4 tracks, 56 events, no overlapping notes, so no group needed). Output: `renders/daw-proof/March Blues Proof Project/March Blues Proof.als` (git-ignored), byte-deterministic (sha256 8e15f9b7…, same on two runs), plus `march-blues-apricity-render.wav` beside it for the A/B.
- Written per note: Time/CurrentStart/CurrentEnd in beats, Loop 0..dur_beats (LoopOn false), WarpMarkers from Event.warp plus the trailing marker 1/32 beat on that the DAW always writes, WarpMode (beats 0, complex 6 = Complex Pro), PitchCoarse/PitchFine from semitones + tuning_cents, SampleVolume = 10^(gain_db/20) (track volume is already in gain_db), FileRef with RelativePathType 1 + absolute Path, OriginalCrc 0, LastModDate 0. Tempo 100 and 4/4 in both Manual and the MainTrack sentinel envelope events, loop brace 0..96, 12 chord locators, scale F mixolydian (Root 5, Name 3).
- The script's own checks pass: unique pointee ids, NextPointeeId above the maximum, one ClipSlot per scene, one send per return, increasing warp markers.

Remaining (needs the DAW): open it on this Mac once the licensed copy is installed (sample paths are absolute to /Users/home/Projects/Apricity/samples). Record every dialog, whether clips sit on the grid, and an A/B against the render. Levels will sit lower than the render, because the proof has no loudness make-up Utility. Steps are in design/daw-set.md, section 'Owner steps'. Left in_progress.
